question.worked_solution:
First, let's rewrite the polynomial equation in the form ${P}_{n}(t)=0.$ To do this, we subtract all the terms from the right-hand side so that the right-hand side becomes $0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}20{t}^{3}+5{t}^{2} & =12t-3{t}^{2} \\ 20{t}^{3}+8{t}^{2} & =12t \\ 20{t}^{3}+8{t}^{2}-12t & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Next, notice that all of the terms of the polynomial have a common factor of $4t.$ We can factor out the $4t$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}20{t}^{3}+8{t}^{2}-12t & =0 \\ 4t(5{t}^{2}+2t-3) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we factor the expression $5{t}^{2}+2t-3$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}4t(5{t}^{2}+2t-3) & =0 \\ 4t(5t-3)(t+1) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, by applying the zero product rule, the solutions are $t=0,$ $t=\frac{3}{5},$ and $t=-1.$
